nodes.title: $\beta_c$ is the unique positive root of $\sinh 2\beta = 1$

nodes.summary: `β_c = ½ log (1 + √2)` satisfies `sinh 2β_c = 1` (H. A. Kramers and G. H. Wannier, *Statistics of the two-dimensional ferromagnet. Part I*, 1941).
nodes.title: Kramers-Wannier critical point

nodes.summary: The finite-volume pressure as `log 2 + (|E|/|V|) log cosh β + log X(tanh β) / |V|`, for `β ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Finite-volume pressure decomposition for $\beta \ge 0$

nodes.summary: Onsager's formula follows from the spin Kac-Ward identities at all `β`.
nodes.title: Onsager's formula from the spin Kac-Ward identities

nodes.summary: Onsager's formula (L. Onsager, *Crystal statistics. I. A two-dimensional model with an order-disorder transition*, Phys. Rev. 65, 1944). For the zero-field nearest-neighbor Ising model with unit coupling on the `L × L` torus, the pressure `log Z_L(β) / L²` converges, for every `β ≥ 0`, to `log 2 + (1 / 8π²) ∫∫_{[-π, π]²} log (cosh² 2β - sinh 2β (cos k₁ + cos k₂))`.
nodes.title: Onsager's formula

nodes.summary: High-temperature expansion (van der Waerden 1941). On a finite graph, `Z(β) = 2^|V| (cosh β)^|E| X(tanh β)` with `X` the even-subgraph generating function.
nodes.title: High-temperature expansion

nodes.summary: Onsager's pressure is continuous at `β_c`. Its non-analyticity there is not part of the statement.
nodes.title: Continuity of Onsager's pressure at the critical point

nodes.summary: The spin Kac-Ward identities follow from the formal Kac-Ward identity on all decorated tori.
nodes.title: Spin Kac-Ward identities from the decorated-torus formal identity

nodes.summary: The spin Kac-Ward identities follow from the edge-weighted root identity on all tori.
nodes.title: Spin Kac-Ward identities from the edge-weighted root identity

nodes.summary: On the `L × L` torus, `p_L(β) = log 2 + 2 log cosh β + log X_L(tanh β) / L²` for `β ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Pressure decomposition on the $L \times L$ torus for $\beta \ge 0$

nodes.summary: The edge-weighted root identity follows from the formal Kac-Ward identity on the decorated torus.
nodes.title: Edge-weighted root identity from the decorated-torus formal identity
